content:
jackie: Heads up — PR #5423 (docs/sdk/auth-migration) preview is failing (linkcheck + Netlify 502). I was assigned as reviewer but I’m OOO tomorrow. Merge window closes EOD today, can someone pick this up?

olivia: On it. Drop the PR link and I’ll triage + re-run the preview.

jackie: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5423 — the failing step shows a timeout connecting to internal-dev:8080 and the Netlify preview 502. I tried a quick rerun and it didn’t help.

ci-bot: CI failed — linkcheck (exit code 1). Logs: https://ci.redwood/workflows/112233/steps/linkcheck

ci-bot: ```
ERROR: requests.exceptions.ConnectTimeout: Connection to internal-dev:8080 timed out after 10s
exit status 1
```

tariq: Seen that before — preview builds occasionally hit an internal service that scales to zero. Two quick paths: 1) make the linkcheck skip external hosts on PR previews, or 2) mock the endpoint in the preview. For a docs PR it's fine to skip external checks on preview.

olivia: I agree. For previews we should not gate the merge on external availability. Suggestion: add PREVIEW=true env in pipeline and if present run linkcheck with --skip-external-links. Main branch keeps full checks.

sam: If we change the pipeline we should update the docs/CI readme and ping rotation owners. @olivia can you open a small CI patch? I can review quickly.

olivia: Will open now. Also, can someone pick up the reviewer assignment for the content itself? Jackie was going to review but OOO — nominating @tariq for the API-snippets check.

tariq: I can take snippet review, give me ~2 hours.

jackie: :thumbsup: there's also a minor link fix (old sdk v0.3 -> v0.4) in one place that needs a quick sign-off.

olivia: Got it. I'll bundle the link fix with the CI toggle into one commit so the preview rebuild uses the updated pipeline.

docs-bot: Preview build created: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-5423 — Netlify build id 7890 (failed)

olsivia_typo: (note: accidental typo in bot name, ignore)

tariq: If the preview remains flaky we can consider a docs-only fast-track: apply label "docs/skip-preview" and do a follow-up audit. Rotation policy allows that for trivial changes, but not for snippet edits that change behavior. This includes code examples.

sam: Rotation policy note: typos/links -> skip-preview ok. Snippets -> require green preview or explicit reviewer approval + canary merge to staging. Since this includes snippets, prefer rerun after CI patch.

olivia: Patch opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5430 (ci: skip-external-on-preview + link fix). I'll merge quickly and re-run the preview for #5423 after.

ci-bot: Workflow 112233 re-run queued.

olivia: I'm taking reviewer duty while Jackie is OOO — assigning myself as reviewer on #5423 and requesting @tariq for snippet verification.

tariq: Requested. I'll leave small inline comments if needed. If good, add label 'docs/ready-for-merge' and @sam can merge in today's window.

sam: I can merge after green CI and one reviewer approval. Tagging @release-crew in case this slips late.

jackie: Thanks all — leaving a quick note in the changelog on what to watch for.

olivia: CI patch merged, preview rebuild started for #5423. I’ll update this thread as soon as it goes green or fails again.

ci-bot: Preview build succeeded: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-5423 (build 7891) — linkcheck: external links skipped for preview per PREVIEW=true.

tariq: Snippets run locally for me, inline comments addressed. Approving now.

tariq: Approved

sam: All clear. Merging PR #5423 to main (merge commit).

docs-bot: PR #5423 merged to main by sam — changelog updated.

jackie: Really appreciate the quick handoff. Back in tomorrow to follow up on any post-merge issues.

olivia: Thanks team — leaving a short follow-up to add the PREVIEW env docs and a note in the reviewer rotation checklist so owners know the fast-path.

sam: Adding a calendar reminder to sync with rotation owners about CI policy next week.

(threads often end with a few emoji reactions; reaction summary: :thumbsup: from jackie, :rocket: from sam)
